subject: PO sequencing audit and spend bracket fix - BlueHighway onboarding
messages:
From: Cam Watanabe <cam.w@bluehighway.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluehighway.com
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: PO mapping + spend cap for Redwood onboarding

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick handshake earlier. We're ready to move forward with Redwood but hit a snag on your PO issuance side: our finance team needs a clean mapping between the PO numbers you will assign and the line-item SKUs we send. Right now the onboarding system is showing a provisional PO (90021-temp) split across three SKU lines and a spend bracket that doesn't match the purchase order submitted from my side.

Can you confirm the final PO number that will be issued once we complete the vendor setup? Also we need the spend cap to reflect the committed quarterly volume (USD 120,000) rather than the provisional ceiling the system shows. If you need our side-by-side SKU list, attaching the Purchase Request export.

Attachments: purchase_request_export.xlsx (attached)

Thanks —
Cam Watanabe
Procurement Manager
BlueHighway Logistics
cam.w@bluehighway.com
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Cam Watanabe <cam.w@bluehighway.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO mapping + spend cap for Redwood onboarding

Cam —

Appreciate the note and the file. Short answer: we can issue a final PO and align the spend bracket to your committed quarterly volume; we just need to do a small sequence audit to reconcile the provisional split. I've started that and attached the onboarding form we need completed (BH_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) plus a proposed mapping (po_mapping_proposal.csv) with suggested SKU-to-line assignments.

Quick questions to speed this up:
- Which SKU lines must remain separate for BlueHighway's internal reconciliation? (I marked SKU-A and SKU-B as separate in the proposal; if both can be combined we can reduce one provisional line.)
- Do you need the PO to reflect quarterly caps per SKU or a single pooled quarterly cap?

Connor and Priyom are looped in to adjust the PO sequence on our side once we have your confirmation — Connor will run the issuance job and Priyom will validate the spend bracket config. If you can return the filled onboarding form and confirm the two questions, we should be able to issue PO 90021 (final) by Monday and replace the provisional token.

Attachments: BH_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (fillable), po_mapping_proposal.csv

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Cam Watanabe <cam.w@bluehighway.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO mapping + spend cap for Redwood onboarding

Hi all —

I ran the sequence audit this morning. Notes below:

- The provisional PO 90021-temp was created during the signup flow and was automatically split into three ledger lines (90021-1, 90021-2, 90021-3) because the incoming PR had three distinct SKU groups.
- Our recommended finalization: consolidate 90021-2 into 90021-1 (those SKUs are not required to be separate per Cam's PR) and keep 90021-3 as a discrete line for the special integration services.
- That consolidation reduces the line-item noise and prevents a downstream duplication in the billing ledger. It will also make the spend cap simpler: we can apply the USD 120,000 quarterly cap at PO 90021 (pooled) rather than per line.

Action items:
1) Cam: confirm you are OK with merging 90021-2 into 90021-1.
2) Cam: return the completed BH_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (we need the signatory block and tax details).
3) Vanessa/Connor: once confirmed, I will run the issuance job to replace 90021-temp with final 90021 and update the ledger mapping.

Attachment: po_mapping_proposal.csv (with annotations)

Connor O'Brien
Vendor Enablement — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
